plan.title: Scholarship Applications Report
plan.subtitle: Summary of scholarship applications for our board

panels.title: Total applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Category distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by district
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 districts by applications
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The total number of applications is {{p1}}. The majority of applications come from the General category, with {{p2.n}} applications. The districts with the most applications are {{p3.n}}. The top 10 districts by applications are listed below. We recommend reviewing the applications from these districts first.
